galgotias-college-of-engineering-and-tec.description: Galgotias College of Engineering and Technology is an autonomous private engineering college in Knowledge Park II, Greater Noida, affiliated to AKTU.
galgotias-college-of-engineering-and-tec.about: GCET was established in 2000. It is an autonomous institute under the UGC Act, approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University. Its B.Tech programmes in computer science, IT, electronics and communication, civil, electrical and electronics, and electrical engineering are NBA accredited.
galgotias-college-of-engineering-and-tec.address: Plot No. 1, Knowledge Park-II, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh
galgotias-college-of-engineering-and-tec.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

gautam-buddha-university.description: Gautam Buddha University is a university in Greater Noida created by a 2002 Uttar Pradesh act, with a 511 acre campus and a school of engineering and technology.
gautam-buddha-university.about: GBU was established by the Uttar Pradesh Gautam Buddha University Act, 2002 (UP Act No. 9 of 2002). It began its first academic session in August 2008 on its 511 acre campus in Greater Noida. It is recognised under Section 12B of the UGC Act and holds a NAAC B+ grade.
gautam-buddha-university.address: Greater Noida, Gautam Budh Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 201312

global-institute-of-information-technolo.description: Global Institute of Information Technology is an AKTU-affiliated college in Knowledge Park I, Greater Noida, near Pari Chowk.
global-institute-of-information-technolo.about: The institute was established in 2002 by the Global Education Trust, New Delhi. Its programmes are approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow. It is located in Knowledge Park I near Pari Chowk metro station.
global-institute-of-information-technolo.address: 32-A, Knowledge Park-1, Near Pari Chowk Metro Station, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh
global-institute-of-information-technolo.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

greater-noida-college.description: Greater Noida College is a private college in Knowledge Park II, Greater Noida, offering an AKTU-affiliated B.Tech programme.
greater-noida-college.about: The college's engineering department has trained software and computer science engineers since 2000. Its four-year B.Tech is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow. The campus is on Plot 6-B in Knowledge Park II.
greater-noida-college.address: Plot No. 6-B, Knowledge Park II, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201310
greater-noida-college.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

greater-noida-institute-of-technology.description: Greater Noida Institute of Technology is a private self-financed engineering college in Knowledge Park II, Greater Noida, with a NAAC A+ grade.
greater-noida-institute-of-technology.about: GNIOT was established in 2001 by the Shri Ram Educational Trust, Noida. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University under college code 132. It achieved NAAC A+ accreditation in its first cycle in 2024.
greater-noida-institute-of-technology.address: Plot No. 7, Knowledge Park-II, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201310
greater-noida-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

i-t-s-engineering-college.description: I.T.S Engineering College is the engineering campus of the I.T.S education group in Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida.
i-t-s-engineering-college.about: The college belongs to the I.T.S group, which runs several campuses in the Delhi NCR region. Its B.Tech and M.Tech courses are affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University. The campus is in Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida.
i-t-s-engineering-college.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

iec-group-of-institutions.description: IEC Group of Institutions is a Greater Noida group whose IEC College of Engineering and Technology offers AKTU-affiliated B.Tech and M.Tech programmes.
iec-group-of-institutions.about: IEC College of Engineering and Technology was established in 1999. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and recognised by AICTE. The group also offers management, pharmacy and other programmes.
iec-group-of-institutions.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

iimt-college-of-engineering.description: IIMT College of Engineering is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college of the IIMT Group in Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida.
iimt-college-of-engineering.about: The college was established in 2005 and sits on a 13.3 acre campus in Knowledge Park III, near the Yamuna Expressway. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University. It holds a NAAC A grade, and some departments are NBA accredited.
iimt-college-of-engineering.address: Plot No. 19 and 20, Knowledge Park-III, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh
iimt-college-of-engineering.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

jaypee-institute-of-information-technolo.description: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology is a deemed-to-be university in Sector 62, Noida, accredited by NAAC with an A grade.
jaypee-institute-of-information-technolo.about: JIIT was established in 2001 and was declared a deemed-to-be university under Section 3 of the UGC Act in 2004. Its campus is at A-10, Sector 62, Noida. It received a NAAC A grade with a CGPA of 3.10 in its second cycle, valid from January 2023 to January 2028.
